notes: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next GSQ-RCO IQ3_S (ISTA DASLab). Sampling is the model file's own recommendation. Speculation tuned on this machine (5 prompts x 2-3 runs, sampled): draft 4 / cutoff 0.8 decodes ~58 tok/s vs ~50 with the engine defaults (3 / 0.5); at temperature 1.0 low-confidence drafts are mostly rejected, so a higher cutoff saves verify work.
